dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple distinct 'O' and 'C' shaped rings with sharp high-contrast perimeters showing a light-to-dark gradient transition from the interior to the exterior, concentrated in the central and posterior-lateral regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of localized, asymmetrical solid high-intensity white pixel clusters without internal gradients, primarily distributed along the upper dorsal ridge.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of three prominent macro-annuli on the posterior-lateral side form an obtuse triangle; two large central macro-annuli form a horizontal linear relationship along the dorsal midline.
